title: Sr. Engineer I - SAP Basis
description:
**A Day in Your Life at MKS:**

As an SAP Basis Architect at MKS, you will partner with IT and internal teams to support, design, implement, and maintain SAP systems across MKS's global SAP landscape. In this role, you will report to the SAP Basis Manager.

**You Will Make an Impact By:**

* Partnering with peers across the IT organization to solve complex business problems and lead the development of high-level solution options and technical approaches.
* Leading technical initiatives such as infrastructure refreshes, data center migrations, and disaster recovery solutions
* Developing SAP infrastructure and application project plans and ensuring delivery of technical milestones established by application delivery managers.
* Driving technical innovation by evaluating and recommending SAP technologies and related products.
* Playing a hands-on role in troubleshooting and resolving significant system issues, including performance bottlenecks and stability concerns.
* Balancing workload between architecture and project activities (approximately 80%) and operational support activities (approximately 20%).
* Managing multiple projects simultaneously while demonstrating strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and customer-facing skills.

**Skills You Bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 8+ years of SAP Basis administration and architecture experience in complex enterprise environments.
* Extensive experience with SAP technologies including SAP ERP, SAP APO, SAP Fiori, SAP GRC, SAP Portal, SAP BW, SAP PO, SAP SSO Server, and SAP Web Dispatcher.
* Strong experience with operating systems including Linux and Windows and databases including Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server, SAP HANA, and MaxDB supporting SAP applications.
* Proven experience performing SAP version upgrades and support package upgrades.
* Hands-on experience with SAP security and authentication technologies including SSO, SNC, SAML, multi-factor authentication, and load balancing.
* Experience in managing SAP Cloud Connector, SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI), and SAP IBP.

**Preferred Skills:**

* SAP certification in SAP Basis, SAP HANA, or related SAP technologies.
* Experience with SAP cloud integration and hybrid landscape architectures.
* Knowledge of automation, monitoring, and orchestration tools used in SAP operations.
* Experience leading offshore technical teams and third-party service providers.
* Strong understanding of ITIL processes, change management, and enterprise operational governance.

.

**Physical Demands and Working Conditions:**

* Ability to work in an office or remote environment using standard computer equipment.
* Ability to sit for extended periods while performing technical and analytical work.
* Occasional participation in after-hours maintenance activities, system upgrades, and production support events.
* May require participation in on-call support rotations for critical SAP production environments.

Globally, our policy is to recruit individuals from wide and diverse backgrounds. However, certain positions require access to controlled goods and technologies subject to various export control regulations. Applicants for these positions may be limited (by, for example, their countries of citizenship, country of origin, or immigration status) where required by law or governmental contact, and/or employment made contingent upon the issuance of appropriate governmental licensing.

MKS Inc. and its affiliates and subsidiaries (“MKS”) is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer: diverse candidates are encouraged to apply. We win as a team and are committed to recruiting and hiring qualified applicants regardless of race, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy and pregnancy-related conditions), religion, age, ancestry, physical or mental disability or handicap, marital status, membership in the uniformed services, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, or any other category protected by applicable law. title: Infrastructure Specialist
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your role**

  

Step into the engine room of enterprise technology, where every decision you make can shape how a customer’s systems perform today - and scale for tomorrow. You’ll dive deep into complex infrastructure environments, solving challenging technical problems, designing seamless integrations and ensuring systems run reliably at every level. Your expertise across networks, endpoints and mainframes, paired with a knack for logical problem-solving and clear documentation, will guide projects from concept to execution. Your solutions will make a real impact that customers notice and remember.
  
  
In this role, you’ll balance hands-on delivery with long-term strategic planning. From analyzing issues and testing solutions to automating processes and integrating across platforms, your work will touch every layer of IT infrastructure. You’ll collaborate with Architects, Technicians and Project Managers, gaining broad exposure and continuous opportunities to grow your skills and influence.
  
  
**What you will do**

* Monitor server health, uptime, CPU, memory, and disk usage.
* Perform routine checks and basic maintenance on Linux/Windows servers.
* Handle alerts from monitoring tools and escalate when required.
* Respond to Level 1 support tickets within defined SLAs.
* Troubleshoot basic server, network, and application issues.
* Document incidents, resolutions, and recurring issues.
* Create and manage user accounts, permissions, and access controls.
* Assist with password resets and basic security configurations.
* Monitor backup jobs and ensure data integrity.
* Assist in basic restore operations when needed.
* Support basic operations in cloud environments (VM provisioning, monitoring).
* Understand core services like EC2 (AWS), Virtual Machines (Azure), or Compute Engine (GCP).
* Assist in managing cloud storage, snapshots, and basic networking.
* Maintain system documentation, SOPs, and troubleshooting guides.
Update knowledge base articles.  

  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

  

* Basic knowledge of: Windows Server / Linux (Ubuntu, CentOS)Networking fundamentals (IP, DNS, DHCP)Monitoring tools (e.g., Nagios, Zabbix)
* Familiarity with: Cloud fundamentals (IaaS, basic VM management)Remote access tools (SSH, RDP)
* Understanding of: Virtual machines and storage concepts Basic cloud architecture Identity and access management (IAM basics)
* Strong problem-solving mindset
* Good communication skills
* Ability to follow SOPs and escalate issues appropriately
* Willingness to learn and grow in cloud and infrastructure domains
7+ years of experience  

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* Certification (optional but a plus): AWS Cloud Practitioner Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900)Google Associate Cloud Engineer (basic exposure)
* Internship or hands-on lab experience in server or cloud environments
* Operating Systems: Windows Server, Linux
* Cloud Platforms: Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform
* Monitoring: Nagios, Zabbix, CloudWatch
Ticketing: ServiceNow, Jira  

  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Integration Architect
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Configure-Price-Quote (CPQ) Business Process Owner

We are seeking an experienced Integration Architect with a strong foundation in **full-stack development, specializing in .NET backend technologies and Microsoft Azure**. The ideal candidate will design scalable and secure solutions while providing technical leadership and aligning architectural strategy with business goals. Guides cross-functional teams through architectural decisions, ensuring technical excellence and innovation.

The preferred Working Model: Hybrid / Remote.

**You will be mainly accountable for:**

* **Solution Architecture:** Design practical, scalable, and secure solutions using .NET and Microsoft Azure that meet business and product needs.
* **Integration & APIs:** Design and guide integrations between applications, APIs, internal systems, and external solutions to ensure smooth and reliable connectivity.
* **Technical Guidance:** Provide technical guidance to development teams across .NET, front-end, database, and cloud technologies, helping teams make sound technical decisions.
* **Azure Solutions:** Design and improve Azure-based solutions with a focus on performance, reliability, security, scalability, and cost effectiveness.
* **DevOps & Engineering Practices:** Support good engineering practices including CI/CD, containerization, infrastructure as code, coding standards, and technical documentation.
* **Architecture & Security Standards:** Ensure solutions follow relevant architecture, security, data privacy, and development standards while keeping governance practical and effective.
* **Cross-Team Collaboration:** Work closely with internal teams and external partners to manage technical dependencies, address challenges, and support successful delivery.
* **Stakeholder Partnership:** Collaborate with Product Owners, business stakeholders, UX, and engineering teams to turn business requirements into effective technical solutions and support the long-term product vision.

**Qualifications for the role:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Around 7+ years of relevant experience in software development, solution architecture, integration architecture, or technical leadership within enterprise environments.
* Strong experience with C#/.NET, ASP.NET Core, Microsoft Azure, and designing modern, scalable applications and APIs.
* Good understanding of system integrations, microservices, event-driven architecture, databases, and modern front-end technologies such as React, Angular, or Vue.js.
* Familiarity with DevOps and cloud engineering practices, including CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes/AKS, and infrastructure as code; experience modernizing existing or legacy applications is an advantage.
* Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively with Product Owners, development teams, business stakeholders, and external partners in a global environment.
* Knowledge of Salesforce CPQ / CLM are preferred.

You don’t need to meet every requirement to apply. If you have .NET and Azure experience and enjoy designing solutions and collaborating across teams, we encourage you to apply.

title: Connect Account Manager
description:

Your insights will directly influence our sales motion, customer playbooks, and broader go-to-market strategy.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Enterprise Selling & Commercial Execution**

  

* Own commercial outcomes—including pipeline generation, opportunity progression, and ARR achievement—for a portfolio of target accounts
* Identify and qualify use-case-driven opportunities for CONNECT platform products, using a consultative, MEDDPICC-informed sales process

* Drive and close new SaaS/Cloud platform deals, with a focus on land-and-expand strategies
* Negotiate commercial terms in alignment with value delivered, usage patterns, and strategic fit

**Platform Adoption & Value Realization**

  

* Support onboarding and deployment strategies to accelerate time-to-value
* Develop usage and expansion plans in partnership with customers and internal teams
* Monitor usage trends, identify adoption gaps, and proactively address risk
* Influence post-sale expansion by championing new use cases and capabilities
* Serve as a customer advocate internally to shape roadmap, pricing, and support

**Strategic Feedback & GTM Iteration**

  

* Capture and share customer insights to improve CONNECT product-market fit and GTM messaging
* Inform commercial model, onboarding approaches, and playbooks for future scale
* Collaborate closely with product, marketing, customer success, partnerships, sales enablement, and regional sales teams

**Essential Requirements:**

  

* Experience in enterprise B2B SaaS or Cloud software roles (e.g., Account Executive, Account Manager, Solution Consultant)
* Proven track record owning and delivering against ARR targets and closing complex deals
* Strong sales acumen, including territory planning, value-based selling, stakeholder mapping, and negotiation
* Experience working with (or selling into) asset-intensive industries like energy, chemicals, or manufacturing is a plus
* Comfort engaging both technical users and business decision-makers
* Experience driving product adoption and account growth post-sale
* Familiarity with sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Challenger, or Command of the Message
* Proficiency with Salesforce and modern sales/customer success tools
* A self-starter who can operate autonomously and influence cross-functional teams

Our Commercial team, comprised of over 2,000 dedicated colleagues, is the backbone of our customer relationships and business growth. From industry experts and solution architects to sales, support, success managers, and business operations, everyone shares a common goal: to deeply understand our customers' needs and deliver tailored solutions.

title: Lead Solutions Architect
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

**The Team:**

Every Celonis outcome starts with data. As a Solutions Architect, you make sure our customers' data gets into the Celonis Platform reliably, securely, and at scale, and that insights and actions flow back out into the systems and AI tools where work actually happens.

**The Role:**

  

In this role you will work across diverse enterprise source systems such as SAP, Salesforce, and cloud databases, with a strong focus on the Oracle technology ecosystem. You will drive data extraction from Oracle environments (Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, Oracle E-Business Suite, Oracle Database and Autonomous Database) and build integrations with Oracle's AI and automation infrastructure.

You will own complex, highly customized integration projects end to end, anticipate blockers before they surface, and shape the best long-term solution together with the customer and Celonis internal teams. You are a trusted technical advisor to customer IT, data, and security leaders, and a go-to partner for colleagues across Services, Product & Engineering, and Go-to-Market.

Beyond day-to-day delivery, you invest part of your time in growing the SA practice: building reusable assets, and driving small initiatives that advance team strategy, including our Oracle integration playbooks.

**The work you'll do:**

**Lead complex data integration and ingestion**

* Own Oracle data extraction. Architect and deliver ingestion from Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, Oracle EBS R12, and Oracle Database / Autonomous Database, including JDBC and PL/SQL-based approaches, while understanding the underlying business processes in these systems.
* Build real-time and CDC integrations. Design change data capture and event-driven architectures using Oracle GoldenGate, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), Kafka, and REST/SOAP APIs, and use them to power Celonis Action Flows.
* Deliver Oracle ERP and other enterprise connections. Lead Oracle ERP connections or cloud based equivalents (e.g. via Oracle BICC). Deliver customized JDBC setups, including Dockerized and real-time configurations.
* Build and own custom API connectors. Design advanced connectors, including complex authentication, pagination, and delta loads, and advise on API design topics such as synchronous versus asynchronous APIs and OData.
* Architect push-based and lakehouse pipelines. Lead Python-based pipelines with Celonis data ingestion API with data engineering and SDLC best practices, and design Landing Zone and lakehouse solutions (for example Databricks, or Microsoft Fabric), including zero copy solutions.
* Solve hard infrastructure problems. Work with customer IT on DMZs, network bridges, WAFs, proxies, certificates, on-premise agent deployments, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) networking.
* Keep pipelines healthy. Tune extraction schedules and delta strategies, optimize database and pipeline performance (for example on Oracle DB and Exadata), and resolve data load failures so customers get timely, trustworthy data.

**Actions, automation, and AI connectivity**

* Deliver advanced writebacks and automation. Configure Action Flows with customized agent settings and direct API-based integrations, including writebacks into Oracle systems, and advise on bot integrations, permissioning, and security.
* Connect Celonis to enterprise AI. Design AI integration patterns that connect Celonis Orchestration and Action Flows with OCI Generative AI Agents, Oracle Select AI (Database 23ai), or Oracle Digital Assistant, and guide customers in connecting Celonis to their LLMs and AI agents through MCP, covering authentication, permissions, and governance.

**Identity, security, and governance**

* Own authentication and provisioning. Configure SSO (SAML, OIDC) with identity providers such as OCI IAM, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, and Ping, and set up SCIM-based user and group provisioning.
* Lead security conversations. Coordinate with the Celonis security team on customer questionnaires, answer questions confidently on live calls, and explain architecture and data flows to customer security and compliance stakeholders.

**Customer and team impact**

* Act as a trusted advisor. Recommend solutions that set the customer up for long-term success, knowing when to build the ideal setup and when to compromise, drawing on best practices in data management, ETL, streaming, and project management.
* Be a recognized expert. Build deep expertise in Oracle integrations and other product areas, give structured feedback to Product & Engineering on Oracle connectors and AI agent capabilities, and become a source of trust for product managers and engineers.
* Advance team strategy. Set up and run initiatives such as knowledge bases and best-practice libraries (for example Oracle integration templates): define goals and success criteria, document the plan, and hold yourself and others accountable.

**The qualifications you need:**

* 8+ years of experience in data engineering, technical consulting, or solutions architecture in a customer-facing role, including leading customer implementations.
* Oracle data engineering experience:hands-on experience extracting data from and understanding business processes in Oracle systems (Fusion Cloud ERP, Oracle EBS R12, Oracle Database / Autonomous Database), with PL/SQL and Oracle SQL skills.
* Oracle Cloud: experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and its integration and data services such as Oracle Integration Cloud, alongside familiarity with AWS, Azure, or GCP is a plus.
* Python and SQL skills, and ETL pipeline creation for large volumes of enterprise data, including migration scripting and custom transformations.
* Hands-on experience with REST/SOAP APIs, authentication patterns, and API design concepts (synchronous and asynchronous APIs, OData).
* Network and security fluency at the level needed to engage customer enterprise IT (DMZ, WAF, proxies, certificates, VPNs), plus comfort with Linux environments.
* Excellent communication and storytelling across written, verbal, and slide formats, tailored to technical and executive audiences, and fluency in English.
* A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with Oracle Exadata, Oracle Select AI (Database 23ai), Oracle Digital Assistant, or Oracle Analytics.
* Familiarity with SAP (ECC/S/4HANA, PI/PO, SNC, RISE, CPI, BTP) or other enterprise ERPs.
* Experience with Snowflake, Databricks, or Microsoft Fabric, and with iPaaS or low-code tools (MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, Power Automate).
* Experience with LLMs, AI agents, or MCP.
* Docker and Linux server administration experience.
* Relevant certifications (Celonis, Oracle/OCI, cloud, or SAP).

**What Celonis can offer you:**

* Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
* Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
* Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
* Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
* Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
* Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
* Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
* Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
* Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

**About Us:**

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

**Celonis Inclusion Statement:**

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that "The Best Team Wins". We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

  

**Your Privacy:**

Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis' Accessibility and Candidate Notices

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

**Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools**  
  
We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.  
  
The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.

Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here.

title: Sr Advisory Solution Consultant - MRD
description:
**Company Description**

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**

**What you get to do in this role:**

* Support product sales as a technical, solution, and industry domain expert within a client-facing sales team pursuing strategic enterprise customers and prospects.
* Bring industry-specific expertise across Manufacturing, Retail, IT/ITES, and/or Telecommunications, with the ability to understand industry operating models, customer journeys, service operations, business processes, technology landscapes, and transformation priorities.
* Translate industry challenges into compelling solution narratives by connecting business outcomes, customer experience, workflow transformation, automation, data, and AI with ServiceNow capabilities.
* Lead executive and technical discovery workshops to uncover customer priorities, operational challenges, transformation opportunities, and desired business outcomes.
* Develop and deliver compelling product demonstrations and solution experiences that reflect real industry scenarios and end-to-end business processes, rather than feature-led demonstrations.
* Engage credibly with senior business stakeholders, CIO/CTO/CBO organizations, enterprise architects, operations leaders, and transformation teams.
* Develop strong client and partner relationships and establish yourself as a trusted advisor throughout the sales cycle.
* Develop solution architectures that demonstrate how ServiceNow integrates with a customer's broader enterprise technology ecosystem, including CRM, ERP, contact center, data, integration, and AI platforms.
* Articulate the role of AI, Agentic AI, automation, workflow orchestration, and data in transforming industry-specific processes and customer experiences.
* Stay current on competitive positioning, industry trends, emerging technology, AI developments, and market differentiation.
* Represent ServiceNow at executive briefings, customer workshops, conferences, industry forums, user groups, partner events, and trade shows.

  
**Qualifications**

**To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* 10+ years of experience in pre-sales Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Technology Consulting, or a comparable customer-facing technology role.
* Strong domain expertise in at least one, preferably more, of the following industries: Manufacturing, Retail, IT/ITES, or Telecommunications.
* Demonstrated ability to understand and articulate industry business processes, customer journeys, operational challenges, transformation priorities, and technology landscapes.
* Experience converting complex business requirements into solution architectures, demonstrations, transformation roadmaps, and compelling executive narratives.
* Experience engaging both business and technical stakeholders, ranging from operational teams to senior executives and enterprise architects.
* Proficiency with the ServiceNow platform or strong technical expertise with enterprise cloud software platforms and architectures.
* Strong understanding of enterprise integrations and the role of platforms such as CRM, ERP, contact center, data platforms, APIs, integration technologies, and AI services within an enterprise architecture.
* Experience working collaboratively with Product Management, Product Marketing, Sales, Partners, Professional Services, and customer technology teams.
* Strong discovery, storytelling, presentation, demonstration, and executive communication skills.
* Ability to operate strategically within complex enterprise accounts while remaining hands-on with solution development and demonstrations.
* Ability and willingness to travel as necessary.

  
**Additional Information**

**Work Personas**

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.

**Accommodations**

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

**Export Control Regulations**

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. title: R0000860 - Professional Services Consultant
description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

**Role description**

We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

**Your Opportunity**

Join our team as a Professional Services Consultant, a critical role focused on the technical design, deployment, and adoption of the New Relic Observability platform for our most strategic customers. You will serve as the deep technical expert, translating complex customer needs into robust, scalable, and automated Observability solutions.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between our product capabilities and the customer's modern, often cloud-native, application and infrastructure environments. You will architect solutions that leverage Platform Engineering best practices, integrating New Relic seamlessly into their CI/CD pipelines, automation frameworks, and internal developer platforms to drive wall-to-wall observability. Your success will be measured by the depth of technical value realized and the long-term strategic adoption of the platform across customer organizations.

**What You'll Do**

* **Architect and Design:** Lead the technical design and architecture of comprehensive New Relic solutions, focusing on large-scale deployment, data correlation strategies, and best practices for instrumenting microservices, serverless, and complex distributed systems.
* **Platform Integration & Automation:** Design and implement automated deployment and configuration solutions for New Relic using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible) and scripting (e.g., Python, Go, Shell). Deeply integrate Observability into customer's Platform Engineering and CI/CD workflows (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab, GitHub Actions).
* **Technical Leadership:** Serve as the subject matter expert on Observability concepts, APM, Infrastructure Monitoring, and Log Management. Lead technical workshops and design sessions with customer architects, engineers, and leadership to define the implementation roadmap.
* **Troubleshooting and Optimization:** Provide advanced technical guidance during initial deployments and optimization phases, addressing complex data ingestion, performance, and platform configuration challenges.
* **Knowledge Transfer & Best Practices:** Create and deliver technical documentation, blueprints, and training to enable customer Platform teams and internal Professional Services/Partner resources to confidently manage and extend the implemented solution.

**Your Qualifications**

We believe that experience comes in many forms and are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive team. If you believe you have the skills to be successful in this role, we encourage you to apply.

* **Extensive Technical Experience:** 5+ years of hands-on experience in a technical consulting, solutions architecture, or senior engineering role, specifically focused on cloud and application performance technologies.
* **Platform Engineering Mastery:** Proven, extensive experience with core Platform Engineering concepts, including building and maintaining automated, self-service infrastructure and delivery pipelines.
* **Automation and DevOps Proficiency:** Deep expertise in **Automation, Scripting (e.g., Python), and CI/CD** practices and tools. Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) is highly valued.
* **Observability Expertise:** Exceptional knowledge and practical experience with **Observability concepts (The Three Pillars) and products (New Relic, Datadog, Dynatrace, etc.)** is **extremely important**. You can articulate the 'why' and 'how' of Observability to technical and non-technical audiences.
* **Cloud Proficiency:** Hands-on experience designing and deploying solutions on major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

title: Identity & Access Management Engineer
description:
**Overview**

The Identity and Access Management Engineer (Junior) will supports the secure and reliable operation of identity services across the organisation. Working under the guidance of senior team members, the role assists with user lifecycle management, access provisioning, authentication, single sign-on, privileged access and identity governance activities.

The position contributes to project delivery and operational support by following approved standards, documenting work, resolving routine issues and escalating risks or complex technical matters appropriately.

  
  

**Key Accountabilities and main responsibilities**

Strategic Focus

* Support the secure and reliable operation of identity and access management services across the organisation.
* Contribute to IAM, PAM and identity governance initiatives through project delivery and operational support activities.
* Assist in implementing identity standards, controls and automation aligned with the organisation’s security strategy.
* Support continuous improvement of identity lifecycle, authentication and privileged access capabilities.

Operational Management

* Manage approved joiner, mover and leaver activities, including user provisioning, de-provisioning, access changes and routine IAM troubleshooting.
* Provision, modify and remove user, service and privileged accounts across supported on-premises and cloud platforms.
* Apply approved access models, including role-based and attribute-based access controls, group membership and entitlements.
* Support periodic access reviews and follow up outstanding certifications, exceptions and remediation actions.
* Assist with the administration, configuration, testing and support of hybrid Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID environments.
* Support application onboarding for single sign-on, multifactor authentication and automated provisioning using SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect and SCIM.
* Contribute to PowerShell, Microsoft Graph and other scripts or workflows that automate repeatable IAM activities, with peer review before production use.
* Assist with identity services hosted across Azure and AWS and their supporting Windows, Linux and virtualised infrastructure.
* Maintain daily IAM platform stability and compliance through service monitoring, BAU engineering, incident troubleshooting, fulfilment of service requests and controlled changes.
* Troubleshoot access, authentication, federation, directory and provisioning issues using documented procedures, system logs and structured diagnostic techniques.
* Support Active Directory Domain Services and related technologies such as LDAP, Group Policy, DNS, certificate services, forest trusts and remote access services under appropriate guidance.
* Maintain accurate tickets, work notes, configuration records, operational procedures and handover information.

People Leadership

* Build effective working relationships with application owners, Service Desk, infrastructure, cloud, security and project teams.
* Collaborate with senior engineers and Identity Architects to deliver IAM and PAM enhancements.
* Demonstrate accountability, teamwork and a commitment to continuous learning.
* Share knowledge and contribute to team capability through structured learning and practical assignments.

Governance & Risk

* Support the discovery and onboarding of privileged accounts across servers, databases, cloud platforms and enterprise applications.
* Assist with implementation and uplift of privileged-access controls, including conditional access, multifactor authentication, least privilege, account discovery and automated password rotation.
* Follow least-privilege, segregation-of-duties, privacy and privileged-access requirements when administering identity services.
* Support audit and assurance activities by maintaining complete access records, approvals, evidence and operational documentation.
* Identify control gaps, recurring incidents and opportunities for automation or service improvement and escalate recommendations through the appropriate process.
* Escalate risks, exceptions and complex technical matters through appropriate governance processes.

The above list of key accountabilities is not an exhaustive list and may change from time-to-time based on business needs.

  
  

**Experience & Personal Attributes**

Experience

* Degree, diploma or equivalent practical training in information technology, computer science, cybersecurity or a related discipline.
* 4+ years of relevant experience in IAM, directory services, systems administration, IT support or cybersecurity; graduates with relevant practical exposure are encouraged to apply.
* Foundational understanding of identity lifecycle management, authentication, authorisation, least privilege, conditional access, multifactor authentication, RBAC and ABAC.
* Practical exposure to Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID in a hybrid environment; familiarity with Microsoft Identity Manager or Entra ID Connect is advantageous.
* Working knowledge of SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SCIM, LDAP, federation and API concepts.
* Basic to intermediate PowerShell and scripting capability; exposure to Microsoft Graph is desirable.
* Awareness of Windows Server and Active Directory services, including Group Policy, DNS, certificate services and forest trusts.
* Foundational cloud knowledge across Azure or AWS and basic familiarity with virtualisation; Linux exposure is desirable.
* Exposure to PAM or IGA platforms such as CyberArk and SailPoint is advantageous.
* Relevant Microsoft, cloud, IAM or security certifications are desirable but not essential.

Personal Attributes
  

* Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to work independently on assigned tasks and seek guidance for complex or high-risk matters.
* Balanced interest in operational support, incident resolution, debugging and engineering delivery.
* Strong attention to detail and a disciplined approach to approvals, testing, evidence and record keeping.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to build constructive relationships with technical teams and business partners.
* Able to prioritise assigned work, meet agreed deadlines, raise blockers early and contribute effectively in a complex enterprise environment.
* Demonstrates integrity, accountability, teamwork and a commitment to continuous learning.

We are committed to support accelerating our Group’s ESG strategy by implementing ESG principles in all our activities and policies. They are translated in our business activity (ESG assessment, reporting, project management or IT activities), our work environment and in our responsible practices for environment protection.

**Diversity and Inclusion**
---------------------------

We are an **equal opportunities employer** and we are proud to make diversity a strength for our company. Societe Generale is committed to recognizing and **promoting all talents** , regardless of their beliefs, age, disability, parental status, ethnic origin, nationality, gender identity, sexual orientation, membership of a political, religious, trade union or minority organisation, or any other characteristic that could be subject to discrimination.

title: AI/ML Expert
description:
Job Description – AI/ML Expert

Position Overview

We are seeking experienced AI/ML professionals from India to join our technology team

in Malaysia. This opportunity is ideal for accomplished AI/ML engineers, data scientists,

machine learning specialists, and applied AI professionals with 5–10 years of relevant

experience who are interested in working on enterprise-grade AI solutions and

contributing to the development of intelligent, scalable, and data-driven applications.

The selected candidate will work closely with engineering, product, data, and business

teams to identify opportunities for applying Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to

real-world business challenges.

The exact designation may be aligned with the candidate’s expertise and experience, such

as AI/ML Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, AI Engineer, Data Scientist, Applied AI

Engineer, or Senior AI/ML Specialist.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, implement, and maintain AI and Machine Learning solutions for

business and technology use cases.

* Analyze complex business problems and translate them into suitable AI/ML

approaches.

* Develop and optimize machine learning models using appropriate algorithms,

frameworks, and techniques.

* Work with structured and unstructured datasets to identify patterns, trends, and

actionable insights.

* Perform data preparation, feature engineering, model training, validation,

evaluation, and optimization.

* Develop production-ready AI/ML pipelines and integrate models into enterprise

applications and platforms.

* Apply techniques such as supervised and unsupervised learning, deep learning,

natural language processing, computer vision, recommendation systems,

forecasting, and predictive analytics, depending on project requirements.

* Explore and implement modern Generative AI and Large Language Model (LLM)

technologies where relevant.

* Develop solutions involving LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector

databases, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, and model

orchestration, where applicable.

* Evaluate emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and models and recommend

appropriate solutions.

* Collaborate with software engineers to deploy AI/ML models into production

environments.

* Monitor model performance, accuracy, scalability, reliability, and data quality after

deployment.

* Identify opportunities to improve model performance through experimentation,

tuning, and continuous learning.

* Design and implement appropriate approaches for model explainability, security,

privacy, and responsible AI.

* Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to the design of scalable AI-

enabled applications.

* Work with cloud platforms and modern MLOps practices for model deployment and

lifecycle management.

* Prepare technical documentation covering models, methodologies, architectures,

experiments, and deployment processes.

* Mentor junior engineers/data scientists and contribute to the development of AI/ML

engineering best practices.

* Stay current with developments in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Deep

Learning, Generative AI, LLMs, and MLOps.

Required Technical Skills

Candidates should have strong practical experience in several of the following areas:

Programming & Data

* Strong proficiency in Python.
* Experience with SQL and relational/non-relational databases.
* Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, statistics, and data analysis.
* Experience with libraries/frameworks such as NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn,

TensorFlow, PyTorch, or equivalent.

Machine Learning

* Strong understanding of machine learning concepts and algorithms.
* Experience with model development, training, validation, evaluation, and

optimization.

* Hands-on experience with regression, classification, clustering, recommendation,

forecasting, or other relevant ML techniques.

* Knowledge of feature engineering, model selection, hyperparameter optimization,

and performance evaluation.

Deep Learning / AI

Experience in one or more of:

* Neural networks and deep learning.
* Natural Language Processing (NLP).
* Computer Vision.
* Speech/Audio AI.
* Time-series analysis.
* Recommendation systems.
* Predictive analytics.
* Generative AI.

Generative AI / LLM

Exposure to or hands-on experience with:

* Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Prompt engineering.
* Embeddings and semantic search.
* Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
* Vector databases.
* Fine-tuning or adaptation of foundation models.
* AI agents and tool/function calling.
* LLM evaluation and optimization.
* Frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent.

Cloud & MLOps

Experience with one or more cloud platforms:

* Microsoft Azure
* AWS
* Google Cloud Platform

Knowledge of:

* Docker and containerization.
* CI/CD.
* Model deployment and monitoring.
* ML pipelines.
* MLOps practices.
* Kubernetes or equivalent technologies is an advantage.

Experience Requirements

* 5–10 years of overall professional experience, with substantial hands-on

experience in AI, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a closely related field.

* Proven experience developing and implementing AI/ML solutions in real-world or

enterprise environments.

* Experience taking AI/ML models from experimentation/prototype stage through

production deployment is highly desirable.

* Candidates should demonstrate strong practical problem-solving ability rather than

purely academic or theoretical knowledge.

* Experience working in cross-functional or distributed technology teams is

preferred.

Educational Qualifications

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence,

Machine Learning, Data Science, Information Technology, Engineering,

Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline.

* Equivalent professional experience and strong technical expertise may also be

considered.

Preferred Qualifications

Candidates with experience in any of the following will be particularly valuable:

* Generative AI and LLM-based applications.
* Enterprise AI platforms.
* Azure AI / AWS AI / Google Cloud AI services.
* MLOps and production ML systems.
* NLP and conversational AI.
* Computer vision.
* AI-powered automation.
* Predictive analytics.
* Big Data technologies.
* API development and microservices.
* .NET/Java/Python-based enterprise application integration.
* Experience working with international clients or multinational organizations.

Soft Skills

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to understand business requirements and convert them into practical AI

solutions.

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to explain complex AI/ML concepts to both technical and non-technical

stakeholders.

* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a multicultural team.
* Curiosity and willingness to continuously learn emerging AI technologies.
* Strong attention to quality, scalability, security, and maintainability.

Location & Mobility

**Work Location: Malaysia**

Candidate Source: India

Candidates currently based in India who are willing to relocate to Malaysia will be

considered.

International candidates with relevant experience and the ability to work from Malaysia

may also be considered based on project and employment requirements.

Candidates should be comfortable working with multicultural and geographically

distributed teams.

What We Are Looking For

We are particularly interested in professionals who can demonstrate:

* Strong hands-on AI/ML engineering capability.
* Experience solving complex real-world problems using AI/ML.
* Ability to build scalable, production-ready solutions.
* Good understanding of the complete AI/ML lifecycle.
* Practical experience with modern AI technologies.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, product, and business

stakeholders.

Candidates with 5–10 years of experience who have progressed from hands-on AI/ML

development into senior-level technical ownership are especially encouraged to

apply.

Engagement Opportunity

The final role title, responsibilities, technology stack, and seniority will be aligned with the

candidate’s experience, technical specialization, and project requirements.

Potential positions may include:

* Senior AI/ML Engineer
* Machine Learning Engineer
* AI Engineer
* Senior Data Scientist
* Applied AI Engineer
* Generative AI Engineer
* LLM Engineer
* AI/ML Technical Specialist
* AI/ML Architect

Application Requirements

Interested candidates should submit:

* Updated CV/Resume.
* Total years of experience.
* Relevant AI/ML experience.
* Current location in India.
* Current/expected compensation.
* Notice period/availability.
* Willingness to relocate to Malaysia.
* Summary of key AI/ML projects handled.
* Details of relevant technical skills, frameworks, cloud platforms, and AI/ML

technologies.

* GitHub, portfolio, publications, or project links, where applicable.

Equal Opportunity

We encourage applications from qualified AI/ML professionals with diverse technical

backgrounds and industry experience. Selection will be based on relevant skills,

experience, technical capability, and suitability for the assigned project and role.

Pay: ₹409,194.83 - ₹1,694,864.16 per year

title: Enterprise Architect
description:
At Solventum, we improve lives by helping healthcare professionals do their best work. Join a team using innovation and insight to make a real impact on the future of healthcare. All roles listed are with Solventum, and we’re committed to protecting your personal information—learn more in our Privacy Policy: https://www.solventum.com/en-us/home/legal/website-privacy-statement/applicant-privacy/

**Job Description:**

**3M Health Care is now Solventum**

**At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.**

**We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.**

**Why Join Us**

* A unique opportunity to shape the architecture of a newly formed global healthcare innovator.
* High visibility to senior executives.
* Modernization initiatives underway (SAP S/4, cloud migration, data platform modernization, AI transformation).
* Ability to influence enterprise operating models and standards across a global organization.
Chance to mature an EA practice from the ground up.  

**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role**

The IT Enterprise Architect is a senior individual contributor role in the Global IT organization, based in India, with significant enterprise influence and visibility. This role serves as a visible change agent that drives business and technology innovation and alignment across Solventum’s global enterprise. The role is expected to operate as a strategic leader within the federated Enterprise Architecture team, drive technology asset management as a strategic imperative, own ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management processes and tooling, and help deliver a unified 3-year enterprise technology roadmap that reduces duplication, increases organizational transparency and agility, and accelerates business growth and transformation. Over time, this role may expand into formal people leadership as the Enterprise Architecture capability matures in India.

This role facilitates EA team activities including defining, documenting, and governing the enterprise IT architecture. The Enterprise Architect leads architecture consulting efforts to investigate and align technology solutions with business strategies, evaluates new and emerging technologies, creates architectural blueprints and target-state definitions, and assures technology solutions are scalable, secure, supportable, and aligned to long-term enterprise architecture direction. The Architect also leads through influence in Architecture Review Board activities that shape technology innovation, govern technology adoption globally, and drive consistent architecture definition across technology domains.

**Primary responsibilities include:**

* **Architecture Governance:** Coordinate, create, publish, and measure adoption of architectural artifacts, including standards, policies, principles, reference architectures, and target-state definitions across technology domains and technology asset classes.

* **Architecture Reviews:** Facilitate Architecture Review Board activities ensuring responsive processes, rightsizing architecture reviews, and strengthening engagement of technical teams, business leaders, and program/project managers.

* **Technology Asset Management Leadership:** Lead technology asset management as a strategic imperative by establishing governance, lifecycle standards, CMDB data quality, ownership models, and decision processes that improve visibility, reduce risk, and enable rationalization across Solventum’s technology portfolio.
* undefined
* **ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management Ownership:** Own and continuously improve ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management processes, data standards, workflows, reporting, and tooling adoption to ensure accurate application inventory, business capability alignment, lifecycle status, technology risk visibility, and actionable portfolio insights.
* undefined
* undefined
* **Technology Architecture Definition:** Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to define current-state, target-state, and transition-state architectures for enterprise technology assets including applications, data and integrations, infrastructure, security systems, and shared platforms. Establish architecture patterns, principles, and roadmaps that align with enterprise strategy and create an integrated, scalable technology landscape.
* undefined
* **Technology Lifecycle Management:** Conduct research, assess and evangelize new technologies where appropriate, and drive lifecycle management for implemented technologies. Partner with business, product, platform, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and operations teams to guide modernization, standardization, consolidation, retirement, and investment decisions.
* undefined
* undefined
* **Delivery Leadership:** Lead architecture delivery through influence by coordinating architects, platform teams, and cross-functional stakeholders in the creation and publication of detailed architectural artifacts and technical solutions. As the capability matures, this role may expand to include formal people leadership responsibilities for architects or architecture delivery teams.

**Your Skills and Expertise:**

To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree or higher AND ten (10) years of Enterprise Architect and/or Technical Architect experience in a private, public, government or military environment

OR

* High School Diploma/GED AND fourteen (14) years of Enterprise Architect and/or Technical Architect experience in a private, public, government or military environment

AND

In addition to the above requirements, the following skills and experiences are also required:

* Enterprise Architecture experience, which includes business, application, data, technology, and security architecture domains, with demonstrated ability to define architecture direction and translate strategy into actionable roadmaps.

* Architecture experience managing architecture review boards, conducting architecture reviews, administering technology governance and portfolio management practices, and driving technology innovation and emerging and AI technology adoption.

* Agile and/or waterfall project management experience

* Experience with one or more of the following technologies or platforms: ServiceNow CMDB and Application Portfolio Management, SAP S/4HANA, Salesforce.com, SAP BTP/Datasphere, MuleSoft, Snowflake, AWS and Azure Cloud, Zscaler, Microsoft 365, Power Platform, and Copilot.

Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:

* **Technology Governance Expertise:** Proven ability to design and govern end-to-end target states, roadmaps, and capability models that align strategy to execution.

* **Technology Architecture and Asset Management Expertise:** Expertise with enterprise architecture frameworks (e.g., TOGAF, Zachman), modeling standards, and modern architecture practices including cloud-native, event-driven, microservices, API-first, agentic operating models, and data-centric architectures.
* undefined
* **ServiceNow APM Process Ownership:** Experience managing technology lifecycles and architecture portfolios using platforms such as ServiceNow CMDB, Application Portfolio Management (APM), and related governance and observability solutions.
* undefined
* **Global Collaboration from India:** Ability to lead globally distributed architecture, platform, and business stakeholders from India, including working effectively across time zones, influencing teams without direct authority, and building credibility as a senior individual contributor.

* Written and verbal communication skills and ability to evangelize and translate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.

* Problem solving and analytical abilities to assess current IT landscape, identify gaps, and develop optimal solutions.

* Leadership skills to influence decision-making, guide architecture delivery, mentor others, and demonstrate readiness to expand into formal people leadership as the organization’s architecture capability grows.

* Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.

Relevant certifications (e.g. TOGAF, AWS/Azure Architect, CISSP/CCSP, ITIL).  



**Work location:** Remote or Hybrid, aligned to Solventum India business needs

**Travel:** May include up to 15%

**Relocation Assistance:** May be authorized, based on Solventum India policy and business needs

**Must be legally authorized to work in country of employment without sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H1B status).**

**Supporting Your Well-being**

Solventum offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, Solventum regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.

Solventum is committed to maintaining the highest standards of integrity and professionalism in our recruitment process. Applicants must remain alert to fraudulent job postings and recruitment schemes that falsely claim to represent Solventum and seek to exploit job seekers.

Please note that all email communications from Solventum regarding job opportunities with the company will be from an email with a domain of **@solventum.com** . Be wary of unsolicited emails or messages regarding Solventum job opportunities from emails with other email domains.

**Please note: your application may not be considered if you do not provide your education and work history, either by: 1) uploading a resume, or 2) entering the information into the application fields directly.**

**Solventum Global Terms of Use and Privacy Statement**

Carefully read these Terms of Use before using this website. Your access to and use of this website and application for a job at Solventum are conditioned on your acceptance and compliance with these terms.

Please access the linked document by clicking here . Before submitting your application you will be asked to confirm your agreement with the
  
terms.

title: Manager, Software Engineering
description:
Candescent is a forward-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in-person channels.

Our Experience-Led, Intelligence-Driven approach combines human-centered design with data, automation, and cloud-based innovation. Built on an API-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.

**Title: Manager, Software Engineering**
========================================

  

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a skilled Software Engineering Manager passionate about delivering exceptional software experiences and leading high-performing teams. As a key leader on the Digital Banking team, this individual will guide the development of features that enhance our clients’ customer experience, ensuring high-quality execution from concept through production. They will work closely with product managers, designers, and cross-functional teams to deliver intuitive, impactful solutions that align with business goals.

The Engineering Manager will lead by example—simplifying complex problems into scalable architectures, championing engineering best practices, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. In a fast-paced Agile environment, they will balance hands-on technical contributions with strategic leadership, empowering engineers to consistently deliver production-ready code. Ideal candidates are collaborative, solutions-focused, and committed to team development, mentoring others while driving technical excellence and operational efficiency.

**Product Summary – Banking Foundations**
-----------------------------------------

The Banking Foundations Engineering team builds modern, consumer-facing digital experiences that are intuitive, scalable, and highly reliable. We focus on creating products that users interact with daily—prioritizing simplicity, performance, and seamless design.

Our engineers work on translating complex backend systems into clean, engaging, and responsive experiences across platforms. From enhancing usability to ensuring resilience at scale, the team plays a critical role in shaping how consumers engage with technology.

Banking Foundations Engineering brings together product thinking, engineering excellence, and user empathy to build experiences that are trusted, accessible, and future ready.

**Key Areas of Responsibility**

* Define product technology strategy and vision
* Manage and prioritize technology roadmap and initiatives
* Own engineering key results and performance metrics

**Product Strategy, Vision, and Planning**

* Partner with Product Managers to develop a technology-aligned product vision and roadmap
* Participate in PI planning and agile ceremonies to provide technical insights for prioritization and delivery
* Identify technology enhancements, product gaps, and feature ideas to inform the roadmap
* Recommend strategic technology investments aligned with business goals and user needs
* Support product teams in translating complex business needs into user stories and technical solutions

**Product Design and Development**

* Oversee design, development, deployment, and maintenance of software solutions across product teams
* Establish and enforce technical standards, guidelines, and best practices for consistency and quality
* Collaborate with Architects and Engineering Managers to manage system dependencies and risks
* Participate in agile development events such as demos and reviews
* Build and mentor high-performing engineering teams with a focus on career development and innovation
* Foster an environment where engineers are encouraged to experiment and contribute new technical ideas
* Provide constructive feedback through code reviews to enhance technical value and quality

**Performance Measurement and Optimization**

* Monitor delivery and quality metrics at the product level to identify trends and drive technical improvements

**Qualifications**

* 12+ years of experience in technology roles, with increasing responsibilities in engineering management
* Strong understanding of multi-tenant, cloud-based, high-transaction systems
* Experience in full-stack enterprise Java development, including React Web and Native
* Expertise in Scaled Agile (e.g., SAFe), Scrum, Lean quality, and test automation methodologies
* Proficiency in programming languages (e.g., Python, Java), cloud technologies, and tools such as Jira
* Strategic technical thinker capable of developing and communicating a product-aligned technology roadmap
* Proven leadership skills to develop and manage cross-functional engineering teams
* Effective collaboration skills to support teams in problem-solving and decision-making
* Experience working with RTEs, STEs, and stakeholders to align and execute strategic themes
* Strong knowledge of continuous delivery and agile at scale practices
* Ability to serve as an Agile coach and advisor, promoting a self-directed and accountable team culture
* Balances technical oversight with empowering teams to innovate and own their solutions
* Drive automation.
* Leverage AI for efficiency and building new functional capability.

**Product Specific Qualifications / Skillsets**

* Experience in Digital banking, Payments and/or Cards domain
* Java, JEE, Spring MVC, Spring Boot, Rest
* React, React Native
* Hibernate, JPA
* Postgres
* Redis
* GCP Cloud

Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, Candescent employees, or any Candescent facility.
