title: Senior Principal - P&C Platform Engineer
description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

Build, automate and run the platform that 50,000+ employees across [X] countries use to communicate and collaborate — Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online and OneDrive, Exchange Online, the Microsoft 365 apps, Power Platform and Microsoft 365 Copilot.

This is the hands-on build role. The Platform Engineer takes architecture direction and a prioritised backlog and turns them into working, tested, automated, documented configuration in production. The expectation is engineering rather than administration: configuration expressed as code and deployed through pipelines, not clicked through a portal and remembered by whoever was on shift.

The role also runs what it builds. Platform Engineers own the operational health of their workloads — diagnosing the awkward, intermittent, only-happens-in-Tokyo problems that never reproduce in a lab, and eliminating the root cause rather than closing the ticket.

**Key Responsibilities**

  
* Design, build, test and deploy configuration across the Microsoft 365 estate: Teams policies, SharePoint and OneDrive settings, Exchange Online transport and mail flow, Purview policies, Entra ID groups and Conditional Access as it applies to collaboration workloads.
* Implement to the reference architecture and standards set by the Principal Architect; raise a design challenge when reality does not match the design rather than quietly deviating.
* Deliver backlog items from sprint to production with the tests, telemetry, documentation and rollback path included — "done" means running and observable, not merely configured.
* Build and maintain integrations using Microsoft Graph and platform APIs; write the connective tissue between M365, ServiceNow, HR systems and the wider application estate.
* Automate everything that would otherwise be done twice. Provisioning, lifecycle, reporting, remediation, joiner/mover/leaver flows, licence assignment and reclamation.
* Express tenant configuration as code in version control; build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for policy and solution deployment with automated validation and staged ring-based rollout.
* Replace manual runbook steps with self-healing and self-service; treat a recurring manual task as a defect with a backlog item attached.
* Own operational health of assigned workloads: monitoring, alerting, capacity, service health response and performance.
* Investigate and resolve complex incidents and problems — third-line escalation for collaboration platform issues — and drive permanent root-cause elimination.
* Participate in an on-call rotation for major incidents affecting the collaboration platform.
* Manage the continuous change stream from Microsoft: assess message centre and roadmap items, test in a lab tenant, and implement, defer or disable with the reasoning recorded.
* Maintain patch, currency and configuration compliance; remediate vulnerabilities and drift.
* Implement and maintain security and information governance controls in the collaboration estate: sensitivity labels, DLP, retention, external sharing controls, app consent and Conditional Access.
* Produce the evidence that audits require — configuration baselines, change records, access reviews — generated automatically wherever possible.
* Build to regulated-environment requirements where applicable, including GxP-validated systems and the qualification and change control they demand.
* Work daily with the Product Owner on refinement and estimation, and with the Architect on design; give honest estimates and flag risk early.
* Produce operational documentation, runbooks and knowledge articles good enough that the service desk can use them and the next engineer can pick the work up.
* Support and coach the service desk and second-line teams; reduce escalation volume by transferring capability, not by absorbing it.
* Mentor junior engineers and contribute to engineering standards and code review within the squad.

**Education & Professional Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent demonstrable professional experience. Strong practical experience is an acceptable substitute for formal qualification.
* Relevant certifications desirable (e.g., Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert, Teams Administrator Associate, Identity and Access Administrator Associate, Information Protection and Compliance Administrator, Power Platform Solution Architect, Azure Administrator, ITIL v4 Foundation).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Hands-on Microsoft 365 platform engineering across the core collaboration workloads — Exchange Online, SharePoint Online / OneDrive and Microsoft Teams — at 50,000-user scale.
* Configuration-as-code for tenant settings — Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated validation and staged ring-based rollout — plus advanced PowerShell and Microsoft Graph automation.
* Microsoft Purview implementation — sensitivity labels, DLP, retention — and the practical behaviour of external sharing, Conditional Access and app consent controls once real users meet them.
* Complex collaboration-platform troubleshooting across client, identity, network and service layers, with root-cause elimination rather than ticket closure.

**Experience Required**

* 15Years overall and 10+ years in IT engineering or platform operations, including 5+ years working hands-on with Microsoft 365 in a production enterprise environment.
* Experience supporting or engineering a tenant of 5,000+ users; comfortable with the difference between a small tenant and a large one.
* Demonstrable hands-on capability across at least two of Exchange Online, SharePoint Online/OneDrive, or Microsoft Teams — at a level that includes troubleshooting, not only configuration.
* Working PowerShell proficiency with real examples of automation delivered into production, plus practical experience calling the Microsoft Graph API.
* Familiarity with Git and pull-request-based working; willingness to work configuration-as-code if not already doing so.
* Experience operating in an ITIL-aligned change and incident process, including production change ownership.
* Experience delivering within a Scrum or Kanban squad, including refinement, estimation and sprint commitment.
* Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation for major incidents.
* Fluent English, written and spoken; able to explain a technical issue to a non-technical colleague.

**Desirable:**

* Experience in a regulated industry — pharmaceutical, life sciences, biotech, financial services or healthcare — including GxP/CSV/CSA and validated-system change control.
* Migration delivery at scale — on-premises Exchange or SharePoint to cloud, file share to OneDrive/SharePoint, tenant-to-tenant, or third-party platform (Slack, Zoom, Google Workspace, Box) consolidation.
* Teams Phone / voice — Direct Routing, Operator Connect, PSTN migration.
* Teams Rooms and collaboration hardware — deployment, configuration and remote management at estate scale.
* Viva suite implementation — Connections, Engage, Learning, Insights.
* Power Platform development — Power Automate flows, Power Apps, Dataverse, Copilot Studio agents.
* A second language beyond PowerShell — Python, C# or Go — and experience building small services or Azure Functions.
* Infrastructure-as-code tooling — Bicep, ARM or Terraform for the Azure resources supporting the platform.
* Endpoint management adjacency — Intune, device compliance and the endpoint's role in Conditional Access.
* Security engineering exposure — Defender for Office 365, Defender for Cloud Apps, threat hunting in M365 audit data.
* Accessibility testing and remediation in collaboration tooling.

**Skills/Background**

  

* Deep hands-on configuration and troubleshooting across the core M365 workloads — Exchange Online (mail flow, transport rules, hybrid, anti-spam), SharePoint Online and OneDrive (site and permission models, sharing controls, migration), and Microsoft Teams (policies, lifecycle, meetings, channels).
* Entra ID as it applies to collaboration — groups and dynamic membership, Conditional Access, app registrations and consent, service principals and app-only authentication.
* Microsoft Purview implementation — sensitivity labels, DLP policies, retention and disposition — and the practical behaviour of each once real users meet it.
* Microsoft 365 apps deployment and configuration — servicing channels, policy management via the Cloud Policy service, add-in management.
* Power Platform administration — environments, DLP connector policies, solution deployment and ALM.
* Microsoft 365 Copilot implementation mechanics — licence assignment, permission and oversharing remediation, and grounding behaviour.
* Advanced PowerShell — modules, error handling, parameterisation, idempotency; scripts written to be maintained by someone else, not just to run once.
* Microsoft Graph API fluency — REST, delta queries, permission scopes, app-only auth, throttling and retry handling.
* Monitoring and diagnostics — Log Analytics and KQL, M365 usage and audit telemetry, Power BI reporting; instrumenting your own work so problems surface before users report them.
* Complex troubleshooting — methodical isolation of intermittent, multi-layer problems spanning client, identity, network and service.
* ITIL-aligned practice — incident, problem and change management executed properly at enterprise scale, including credible change records and rollback plans.
* Production discipline — testing in a lab tenant first, ring-based release, blast-radius awareness, and the habit of asking "what does this do to 50,000 people" before pressing apply.
* Clear technical writing — runbooks, knowledge articles and design notes others can actually follow.
* Ownership — sees an item through to working in production and stays with it when it misbehaves afterwards.
* Curiosity and self-direction — reads release notes, tests in a lab, and brings improvement ideas to refinement unprompted.
* Collaboration — works well with product, architecture, security and the service desk; explains technical constraint without condescension.
* User empathy — remembers that a policy setting is somebody's Monday morning.

**Skills**

Access Control (AC), Agile Methodology, Cisco Routing, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Data Analysis, Design Thinking, DevOps, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Data Migration Testing, Microsoft Office 365, Operator Interfaces, Prioritization, Product Development Research, Product Roadmapping, Project Management, Return on Investment (ROI), Software Development, Strategy Deployment, User Experience (UX), User Interface (UI) Design

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. title: Solutions Architect | India
description:
#### **Why Cast AI?**

Cast AI is an automation platform that operates cloud-native and AI infrastructure at scale. By embedding autonomous decision-making directly into Kubernetes and cloud environments, Cast AI continuously optimizes performance, reliability, and efficiency in production.

The old way doesn't work. As Kubernetes and AI environments grow, manual decisions don't. Cast AI replaces tickets, alerts, and manual tuning with continuous automation that adapts infrastructure as conditions change. Efficiency and cost savings follow naturally from that automation.

Over 2,100 companies already rely on Cast AI, including Akamai, BMW, Cisco, FICO, HuggingFace, NielsenIQ, Swisscom, and TGS.

**Global team, diverse perspectives**  
We're headquartered in Miami, but our impact is international. We take a global and intentional approach to diversity. Today, Cast AI operates across 34 countries spanning Europe, North America, Latin America, and APAC, bringing a wide range of perspectives into how we build and lead.

**Unicorn momentum**  
In January 2026, we achieved unicorn status with a strategic investment from Pacific Alliance Ventures, the corporate venture arm of Shinsegae Group (a $50+ billion Korean conglomerate). Our valuation now exceeds $1 billion, and we're just getting started.

**Join us as we build the future of autonomous infrastructure.**

#### **About this role:**

We are hiring a Solutions Architect to join our Customer Success team and support strategic customers across APAC.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing technical role for someone with strong Kubernetes, SRE and DevOps experience. You will work alongside Technical Account Managers and Client Partners, becoming the escalation point when a customer conversation requires deeper technical expertise, stronger architecture guidance or support with a complex production issue.

You will work directly with customers to understand their Kubernetes environment, diagnose technical challenges, guide them towards the right Cast AI solution and help them realise more value from the platform. You will also identify and support expansion opportunities, including positioning Omni where it can solve a meaningful customer problem.

This is not a traditional post-sales support role. You need to be comfortable in front of senior technical stakeholders, able to explain complex Kubernetes topics clearly and willing to travel to customer sites when needed.

The role covers APAC.

#### **Requirements:**

* Six to twelve years of relevant experience in SRE, DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, Solutions Engineering or a similar role.
* Strong hands-on Kubernetes experience. You need to understand how clusters, workloads, networking, scaling and resource management operate in production.
* Meaningful prior experience as an SRE or DevOps Engineer. This is essential. Candidates without a real operational background are unlikely to succeed in the technical interview or the role.
* Experience troubleshooting production incidents, including diagnosing root cause, resolving the issue and implementing improvements afterwards.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure and modern cloud-native tooling.
* Able to communicate technical concepts in a logical, clear and customer-friendly way.
* Comfortable speaking with engineering leaders, platform teams, SREs, DevOps teams and senior technical stakeholders.
* Interested in a customer-facing role, whether you already work with customers or want to move from a deeply technical role into one.
* Comfortable operating in a fast-growing, less structured environment where ownership and initiative matter.
* Willing to travel to customer locations for a few days per month.

#### **Responsibilities****:**

* Act as the senior technical escalation point for strategic and complex customer conversations.
* Partner with Technical Account Managers on customer onboarding, adoption, technical risk and platform value.
* Work with Client Partners to identify and support expansion opportunities within existing customers.
* Lead technical discovery sessions with customers to understand their Kubernetes architecture, workloads, operational challenges and priorities.
* Advise customers on Kubernetes reliability, efficiency, scaling and platform best practices.
* Help customers diagnose and resolve complex production issues involving Kubernetes clusters, workloads, resource management, networking or platform reliability.
* Represent Cast AI in customer meetings, technical workshops and occasional on-site visits across APAC.
* Support the commercial adoption of Omni by connecting product capabilities to genuine customer needs.
* Share recurring customer feedback, technical blockers and product opportunities with Product and Engineering teams.
* Work closely with a team of SREs and cloud infrastructure specialists within Customer Success.

#### **What's in it for you?**

* Enjoy a flexible, remote-first global environment.
* Collaborate with a global team of cloud experts and innovators, passionate about pushing the boundaries of Kubernetes technology.
* Equity options.
* Get quick feedback with a fast-paced workflow. Most feature projects are completed in 1 to 4 weeks.
* Spend 10% of your work time on personal projects or self-improvement.
* Learning budget for professional and personal development - including access to international conferences and courses that elevate your skills.
* Team-building budget and company events to connect with your colleagues.
* Equipment budget to ensure you have everything you need.
* Extra days off to help maintain a healthy work-life balance.

#### **Hiring process**

* Screening call with Recruiter
* Hiring Manager interview
* 1-2 additional interviews based on the role
* Culture Check interview with an executive

* *As part of our standard hiring process, we would like to inform you that a background check may be conducted at the final stage of recruitment through our third-party provider, Checkr.*
* *Please note that Cast AI* *does not* *provide any form of visa sponsorship/work permit.*

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

  
  
  

Docusign brings agreements to life. More than 1.8 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using the Docusign AI-native IAM platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

  
  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  
  
  

As the Manager of the Extensibility Platform team at Docusign, you will lead a high-performing, cross-functional engineering team focused on developing and scaling the Extensibility Platform, as well as building new Extension Types and first-party applications. The platform enables internal and external developers to create applications that integrate seamlessly with Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management (IAM) systems. Developers can publish their applications through the Developer Console, making them available in the Docusign App Center for customers to discover and install. You will bring hands-on technical leadership through coding, code reviews, and driving the design and evolution of engineering architectures. You will help ensure the platform remains scalable, configurable, and capable of supporting diverse business scenarios, while strengthening collaboration and communication across engineering, product, and other partner teams.

This position is a people manager role reporting to the Senior Director, Software Engineering.

**Responsibility**

* Conduct thorough code reviews to maintain code quality, reliability, security, and engineering standards
* Create, review, and drive engineering architectures that enable a scalable, configurable Extensibility Platform
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers on design decisions, implementation approaches, and best practices
* Partner with engineering, product, design, and other teams to align technical solutions with platform and customer needs
* Define and communicate a clear technical vision and strategic roadmap for the Extensibility Platform, emphasizing usability, performance, and scalability
* Work closely with product managers, architects, and other stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver features critical to business success
* Guide the team in producing high-quality, maintainable code, with a strong focus on best practices in testing, monitoring, and logging
* Promote best practices in DevOps, continuous deployment, and Agile methodologies to enhance development efficiency and product quality
* Mentor and develop engineering talent, fostering a culture of innovation, continuous learning, and collaboration
* Engage with external developers and partners to expand the ecosystem of integrations available through the Docusign App Center

  

**Job Designation**
-------------------

  
  
  

**Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

Positions at Docusign are assigned a job designation of either In Office, Hybrid or Remote and are specific to the role/job. Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

  
  

**What you bring**
------------------

  
  
  

**Basic**

* 5+ years of software development and management experience across multiple languages/frameworks (or equivalent)
* 5+ years of hands-on coding or equivalent
* 5+ years of leading software teams of 5+ people or equivalent
* Proven track record in building solutions that consume and expose APIs/web services
* Experience in SaaS or Cloud environments

**Preferred**

* Expertise with high-availability (99.99%+) distributed systems
* Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile methodologies
* Curiosity and adaptability in learning new tech stacks
* Experience building and scaling platform components for app marketplaces or similar ecosystems
* Prior involvement in designing secure, reliable integrations with third-party apps or services
* Experience in integrating with 3rd party enterprise systems
* Experience in building enterprise software and platforms

  

**Life at Docusign**
--------------------

  
  
  

**Working here**

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

**Accommodation**

Docusign is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need such an accommodation, or a religious accommodation, during the application process, please contact us at accommodations@docusign.com.

If you experience any issues, concerns, or technical difficulties during the application process please get in touch with our Talent organization at taops@docusign.com for assistance.

Assent empowers manufacturers and distributors with the intelligence to build sustainable products, meet global compliance requirements and drive better business outcomes.

At the center of our offering is the Assent Network, the industry’s most complete Product Intelligence Network, bringing together trusted parts and supplier intelligence, advanced AI and deep regulatory expertise to help organizations identify risk, make informed decisions and stay ahead of evolving requirements.

Trusted by more than 1,000 customers worldwide, Assent helps organizations stay ahead of evolving regulations across areas including responsible sourcing, human rights due diligence, PFAS reporting, Digital Product Passports, and other emerging requirements. Our platform empowers manufacturers to navigate change with confidence while building stronger supplier relationships and driving measurable business value.

With more than 1000 team members across India, North America, Malaysia, the European Union, and Kenya, Assent brings together global expertise, diverse perspectives, and a shared commitment to innovation. Our hybrid work model enables teams to collaborate across regions while staying connected to the communities where they live and work. As a certified B Corporation, we meet rigorous standards of social and environmental performance, transparency, and accountability, reflecting our commitment to creating lasting value for our customers, our people, and the planet.

**People First. Technology Forward.**

Our commitment to People, Culture & Community (PCC) is rooted in building a diverse, inclusive, and high-performing team. We recruit and retain team members with a range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, while fostering a culture of belonging where all Assentees are respected, supported, and empowered to contribute.

As we continue to embed AI into how we work, we do so thoughtfully, enhancing human potential, supporting better decision-making, and prioritizing appropriate oversight, privacy, and fairness.

At Assent, we value your privacy and are committed to maintaining transparency in how we handle your personal information. As part of our talent acquisition and management processes, we may use AI technologies to support activities such as resume screening, candidate communication, and talent analytics.

 **Job Description**

**Position Summary**

The Senior Cloud Operations Specialist is a senior technical owner for the stability, security, governance, and resilience of Assent's enterprise AWS environment and SaaS production systems. The role combines hands-on cloud operations with solution architecture, technical leadership, and sound risk-based decision making across a large multi-account AWS estate.

Working within the SaaS Product Infrastructure group, this individual partners with Engineering, Product, Corporate Security, and IT to design and operate secure, highly available cloud services. The successful candidate works independently at a high level, turns business and technical requirements into practical solutions, and constructively challenges decisions that introduce unnecessary risk, operational burden, or architectural debt.

This role follows a strict code-first and least-privilege operating model. Infrastructure changes are codified, peer-reviewed, and delivered through approved pipelines. Privileged access is exceptional, time-bound, auditable, and used only when required.

**Responsibilities**

**Architecture Technical Leadership and Decision Making**

* Lead the design and delivery of secure, scalable, resilient, and supportable AWS solutions from initial requirements through production operation.
* Translate business, security, compliance, and operational requirements into architecture decisions, implementation plans, and reusable platform patterns.
* Evaluate technical options and make clear, risk-based recommendations that balance security, reliability, maintainability, delivery speed, and cost.
* Question assumptions and respectfully challenge designs or delivery approaches that conflict with enterprise standards, least-privilege principles, reliability objectives, or long-term platform health.
* Participate in architecture and design reviews, document key decisions and tradeoffs, and ensure operational readiness before production adoption.
* Act as a senior technical escalation point, lead complex infrastructure initiatives, and coach team members through design and operational decisions.

**AWS Platform Governance Identity and Privileged Access**

* Own and continuously improve Assent's AWS multi-account environment using AWS Organizations, AWS Control Tower, organizational units, account lifecycle controls, guardrails, and Service Control Policies.
* Architect and operate AWS IAM Identity Center, IAM roles and policies, permission sets, trust relationships, permission boundaries, federation, and cross-account access patterns.
* Apply least privilege by default. Ensure elevated access is approved, time-bound where supported, protected by strong authentication, logged, regularly reviewed, and separated from day-to-day identities.
* Maintain controlled break-glass access and prevent shared credentials, unmanaged access paths, unnecessary standing privilege, and unreviewed administrative changes.
* Lead account provisioning, compliance assessments, access reviews, drift detection, and remediation across the AWS organization.
* Partner with Corporate Security on identity governance, audit readiness, cloud control design, and the implementation of enterprise security requirements.

**Enterprise AWS Networking**

* Design, operate, and troubleshoot enterprise AWS network architectures across accounts and regions, including VPCs, subnets, route tables, security groups, network ACLs, and shared network services.
* Own connectivity and traffic-flow patterns using services such as Transit Gateway, VPC peering, PrivateLink, VPN, Direct Connect, Route 53, Elastic Load Balancing, API Gateway, and CloudFront.
* Design secure ingress, egress, segmentation, DNS, and service-to-service connectivity patterns using AWS Network Firewall, AWS WAF, VPC endpoints, flow logs, and centralized inspection where appropriate.
* Diagnose complex routing, name resolution, load-balancing, firewall, latency, and cross-account connectivity issues and drive permanent corrective action.
* Maintain current network diagrams, traffic-flow documentation, connectivity standards, and recovery procedures.

**Infrastructure as Code Automation and Delivery**

* Provision and govern AWS platform resources through Terraform using reusable modules, secure remote state, controlled workspaces, and maintainable multi-account patterns.
* Use GitHub Actions as the primary delivery mechanism for infrastructure and governance changes, with peer review, validation, security checks, approvals, and traceable deployment records.
* Uphold a no unmanaged changes standard. Use AWS console access only for approved operational needs, and codify or reconcile any necessary emergency change promptly.

* **Build automation with Python, PowerShell, Bash, Lambda, Ansible, Semaphore, or similar tools to reduce manual effort, enforce consistency, and improve recovery time.**
* **Review infrastructure code and automation for security, reliability, maintainability, and alignment with enterprise standards.**

**Cloud Operations Reliability and Incident Response**

* Operate and improve core AWS services across compute, containers, databases, storage, messaging, DNS, content delivery, security, and monitoring.
* Install, configure, secure, patch, and troubleshoot Linux and Windows workloads in cloud environments.
* Establish effective monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboards, and automated remediation using CloudWatch, OpenSearch or Elasticsearch, New Relic, PagerDuty, or comparable platforms.
* Lead or support high-severity incident response, communicate clearly under pressure, restore service safely, and coordinate across technical and business teams.
* Conduct root-cause analysis and ensure corrective actions address underlying technical and process failures rather than only immediate symptoms.
* Participate in the on-call rotation and planned off-hours work required to support production infrastructure.

**Security Compliance Resilience and Operational Ownership**

* Maintain enterprise standards for encryption, key management, audit logging, configuration compliance, vulnerability remediation, and evidence collection using services such as KMS, CloudTrail, and AWS Config.
* Support internal and external audits and provide clear evidence of cloud controls, access governance, and operational processes.
* Design, implement, and test backup, business continuity, disaster recovery, and multi-region resilience capabilities.
* Create and maintain accurate documentation for cloud architecture, governance controls, operational procedures, automation workflows, and support handoffs.
* Take end-to-end ownership of assigned platforms and initiatives, surface risks early, and follow decisions through implementation and operational acceptance.

 **Qualifications**

**Minimum Requirements**

* 7 or more years of relevant experience in cloud operations, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, or systems administration, including substantial hands-on responsibility for enterprise AWS environments.
* Proven long-term ownership of a multi-account AWS organization using AWS Organizations, AWS Control Tower, and AWS IAM Identity Center.
* Deep experience with enterprise AWS governance, including organizational design, account provisioning, Service Control Policies, guardrails, configuration compliance, and drift remediation.
* Advanced knowledge of AWS identity and access management, including least privilege, privileged-access controls, federation, cross-account access, permission sets, IAM policies and roles, and emergency access practices.
* Strong AWS networking experience, including multi-account and multi-region network design, routing, DNS, load balancing, private connectivity, segmentation, and network security controls.
* Strong Terraform experience, including reusable modules, multi-account deployment patterns, secure remote state in Amazon S3, code review, testing, and lifecycle management.
* Hands-on experience building and maintaining GitHub Actions pipelines for infrastructure deployment, policy enforcement, and operational automation.
* Demonstrated ability to architect solutions and carry them through implementation, validation, documentation, and production support.
* Sound judgment in ambiguous or high-pressure situations, with the confidence to challenge proposals, explain risk clearly, and make defensible technical decisions.
* Strong scripting and automation skills in Python, PowerShell, or Bash.
* Working knowledge of Linux and Windows administration in production cloud environments.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams, security stakeholders, leadership, and vendors.
* Ability to work independently as part of a globally distributed team and to participate in on-call and planned off-hours work.
* University degree, college diploma, or equivalent practical experience.
* AWS certification at the Associate level or higher, or equivalent demonstrated enterprise AWS expertise.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Account Factory for Terraform or Customizations for AWS Control Tower.
* AWS Solutions Architect Professional, Advanced Networking Specialty, or Security Specialty certification.
* Experience with ECS or Fargate, EC2, RDS for PostgreSQL or SQL Server, S3, SQS, SNS, SES, Amazon MQ, API Gateway, CloudFront, and Route 53.
* Experience with enterprise configuration management and automation using Ansible, Semaphore, or comparable tooling.
* Experience with OpenSearch or Elasticsearch, New Relic, PagerDuty, Datadog, SolarWinds DPA, or comparable observability and performance platforms
* Familiarity with Auth0 or other enterprise identity providers.
* Experience designing and testing disaster recovery across AWS accounts and regions.
* Experience in enterprise SaaS, regulated industries, or high-security cloud environments.

 **Additional Information**

**Life at Assent**

**Wellness:** We believe that you and your family’s well being is important. As a result, we offer vacation time that increases with tenure, comprehensive benefits packages (details vary by country), life leave days and more.

**Financial Benefits:** It’s not all about the money – well, it’s a little about the money. We understand that financial health is important and we offer a competitive base salary, a corporate bonus program, retirement savings options and more.

**Life at Assent:** There is purpose beyond your work. We provide our team members with flexible work options, volunteer days and opportunities to get involved in corporate giving initiatives.

**Lifelong Learning:** At Assent, curiosity is not only valued but encouraged. You will receive professional development days that are available to you the day you start.

At Assent, we are committed to growing and sustaining an environment where our team members feel included, valued, and heard. Our diversity and equal opportunity practices are guided and championed by our Diversity and Inclusion Working Group and our Employee Resource Groups (ERGs).

Our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion includes recruiting and retaining team members from diverse backgrounds and experiences, and fostering a culture of belonging where all team members are included, treated with dignity and respect, promoted on their merits, and placed in positions to contribute to business success.

If you require assistance or accommodation throughout any part of the interview and selection process, please contact talent@assent.com and we will be happy to help.

We use AI to support parts of our recruitment process, such as note-taking and initial shortlisting based on job-related qualifications. AI does not make hiring decisions. All candidates will speak with a real person, and final decisions are always made by our recruitment team.

title: Senior Solutions Architect – AI Infrastructure Networking (remote in India)
description:
**Company Description**

**About Mirantis**

Mirantis, an IREN company, is the Kubernetes-native AI infrastructure company, enabling organizations to build and operate scalable, secure, and sovereign infrastructure for modern AI, machine learning, and data-intensive applications. By combining open source innovation with deep expertise in Kubernetes orchestration, Mirantis empowers platform engineering teams to deliver composable, production-ready developer platforms across any environment—on-premises, in the cloud, at the edge, or in sovereign data centers. As enterprises navigate the growing complexity of AI-driven workloads, Mirantis delivers the automation, GPU orchestration, and policy-driven control needed to manage infrastructure with confidence and agility. Committed to open standards and freedom from lock-in, Mirantis ensures that customers retain full control of their infrastructure strategy. https://www.mirantis.com/

 **Job Description**

About the role

We are seeking a Senior Solutions Architect with deep networking expertise to join the Voyager team in the Mirantis Office of the CTO. You will own the network solutioning of k0rdent AI, our platform for building and operating GPU clouds and AI factories, from metal to model.

You will design how large GPU clusters are interconnected, how tenants are isolated, and how workloads reach the network from containers, virtual machines and bare metal nodes. You will turn that design into published reference architectures, working code and proofs of concept that run on real hardware with our customers and partners.

As part of the Office of the CTO, research is a core part of the job. You will explore designs and technologies before customers ask for them, prototype ideas that may not ship, and challenge established practice when a better approach exists. Your work will shape where k0rdent AI goes next, not only how it is deployed today.

This role combines research with hands-on, outward-facing work. You will split your time between exploring new designs, writing architecture, building and validating it in the lab, and explaining it to engineers, executives and conference audiences. You will work with Solutions Architects, Partner Management and Engineering colleagues across many countries and time zones.

Key Responsibilities

Reference architecture

* Design and publish network reference architectures and solution designs for k0rdent AI, covering data center topologies from a single rack to multi-thousand-GPU clusters.
* Define compute (east-west) fabrics on InfiniBand and on RoCEv2 Ethernet, including rail-optimised and fat-tree / Clos designs, oversubscription and failure-domain choices.
* Define front-end, storage and management networks, and how they connect to customer data centers, public clouds and hybrid environments.
* Specify multi-tenant isolation across the stack: InfiniBand partitions (PKeys), VRFs and EVPN-VXLAN on Ethernet, and Kubernetes-level network policy.
* Document scale limits and trade-offs (cost, performance, operability, vendor lock-in) with defensible reasoning a customer can follow.

Host and platform networking

* Define how Linux hosts expose NICs, DPUs and SuperNICs to workloads: PCI passthrough, SR-IOV virtual functions, IOMMU groups, NUMA and GPU-NIC affinity.
* Design Kubernetes networking for AI workloads: primary and secondary CNIs, Multus, SR-IOV and RDMA device plugins, NVIDIA Network Operator, and Dynamic Resource Allocation (DRA).
* Design networking for virtual machines on KubeVirt, including passthrough and SR-IOV for GPU and RDMA traffic.

Research and exploration

* Track and evaluate emerging technologies and standards in AI networking, such as Ultra Ethernet (UEC), SuperNIC and DPU offloads, scale-up and scale-across fabrics, and Kubernetes DRA network drivers.
* Prototype alternative designs in the lab, including ones customers have not yet asked for, and measure them against current practice.
* Challenge established or customer-preferred designs when evidence points to a better option, and make the case with data.
* Publish findings as internal research notes and design proposals and, where appropriate, as external papers, blog posts or talks.

Code and proofs of concept

* Build and run proofs of concept with customers and partners, on Mirantis lab hardware and on customer sites, and report results against agreed success criteria.
* Write automation and tooling (Python, Go, Bash, Ansible, Helm, Kubernetes manifests, Terraform) that makes the reference architectures reproducible.
* Run validation and benchmarking of fabrics and host configurations (e.g. NCCL tests, perftest, ib\_write\_bw) and turn findings into design guidance.

Customers, partners and community

* Act as the network subject matter expert in customer discovery, design reviews and architecture workshops, bringing thought leadership and new ideas rather than only reflecting current practice.
* Work with hardware and networking partners (e.g. NVIDIA, server OEMs, switch and network vendors) on joint designs and validations.
* Innovate and feed research results back to Product and Engineering, and help shape the k0rdent AI roadmap.
* Present at industry events, webinars and partner summits, and run hands-on workshops for technical audiences.
* Write technical content: reference architecture documents, solution briefs, blog posts and internal enablement.

 **Qualifications**

Education and experience

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8+ years in network engineering or network architecture, with at least 3 years in data center, HPC or cloud infrastructure networking.
* Customer-facing experience as a solutions architect, pre-sales engineer, consultant or technical lead.

Required technical skills

* Data center network design: spine-leaf and Clos topologies, rail-optimised GPU fabrics, oversubscription, ECMP, and the operational challenges of scaling to thousands of nodes.
* InfiniBand: subnet management, partitioning, adaptive routing, and how NCCL / RDMA traffic behaves on the fabric.
* RoCEv2 on Ethernet: lossless and congestion-controlled designs (PFC, ECN, DCQCN), QoS, MTU and buffer tuning.
* Routing and overlays: BGP, EVPN-VXLAN, VRFs and their use for multi-tenancy.
* Hybrid and multi-cloud connectivity: interconnects, VPN, cloud provider networking constructs, and IP address and DNS planning across sites.
* Linux networking: how the kernel and drivers manage NICs, PCI passthrough, SR-IOV, IOMMU, NUMA affinity, and tools such as iproute2, ethtool and devlink.
* Kubernetes networking: CNI plugins (e.g. Cilium, Calico, OVN-Kubernetes), Multus and secondary networks, SR-IOV and RDMA device plugins, network policy and service exposure.
* Virtualisation on Kubernetes: KubeVirt, and how VM networking, passthrough and SR-IOV are configured there.
* Programming or scripting in at least one language (Python or Go preferred), and comfortable using Git, CI and infrastructure-as-code.

How you work

We hire for these behaviours as much as for technical depth, and will ask for concrete examples of each.

* Curious. You dig into why a fabric behaves the way it does, read the specs and the source, and keep up with how AI networking is changing. You question established designs, including the ones customers are used to, when there is a better way.
* Ownership. You take a reference architecture or a POC from the first sketch to a published, validated result, and you stand behind it.
* Proactive. You spot gaps in the product, the documentation or a customer design before you are asked, and you act on them.
* Fast learner. You get productive quickly in unfamiliar hardware, software or customer environments.
* Business acumen. You connect network design choices to cost, time-to-value and risk, and explain them in those terms to decision makers.

Communication and collaboration

* Excellent written and spoken English; you write documents others can build from.
* Comfortable presenting to large audiences at conferences and events, and running hands-on workshops.
* Able to adapt the message to the audience, from network engineers to customer executives.
* Experience working in an international, distributed company, across time zones and different work cultures, with Solutions Architects, Partner Management and Engineering teams.

Nice to have

* Hands-on experience with NVIDIA networking: Quantum InfiniBand, Spectrum-X Ethernet, ConnectX SuperNICs, BlueField DPUs, UFM, and NVIDIA reference designs for AI factories.
* Experience with GPU cloud, neocloud or HPC operators, or with NVIDIA Cloud Partner (NCP) style deployments.
* Bare-metal provisioning and lifecycle: Metal3, Ironic, Redfish, PXE / iPXE, and Cluster API.
* Network automation and SDN controllers, and switch operating systems such as Cumulus Linux, SONiC or vendor equivalents.
* Global load balancing and service exposure for distributed inference (GSLB, Gateway API, ingress).
* Familiarity with Software-Defined Storage networking for AI (NVMe-oF, GPUDirect Storage).
* Experience with Mirantis products, MKE, k0s, k0rdent networking.
* Contributions to open-source networking or Kubernetes projects, or a track record of public talks and technical writing.
* Participation in standards or industry bodies (e.g. Ultra Ethernet Consortium, OCP, IETF), or published research, patents or white papers.
* Additional languages beyond English, for example a European language.

Location, travel and working model

This role is remote, open to candidates based in Europe.

* You will work with a team spread across many time zones; some meetings will fall outside standard local hours.
* Travel of up to 25% for customer engagements, partner meetings, lab work and industry events, primarily within the EU and US.
* Mirantis is an equal opportunity employer. Compensation and benefits are set according to the local market and employment arrangement.

 **Additional Information**

**Why you’ll love Mirantis**

* Build the observability foundation for the AI cloud era, working directly with leading GPU cloud operators, NeoClouds, sovereign clouds, and AI-first enterprises
* Collaborate with a world-class, distributed team committed to openness and technical excellence
* Shape the product narrative and influence go-to-market success

**It is understood that Mirantis, Inc. may use automated decision-making technology (ADMT) for specific employment-related decisions. Opting out of ADMT use is requested for decisions about evaluation and review connected with the specific employment decision for the position applied for. You also have the right to appeal any decisions made by ADMT by sending your request to isamoylova@mirantis.com**

By submitting your resume, you consent to the processing and storage of your personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws, for the purposes of considering your application for current and future job opportunities.

**Ready to turn bold ideas into real-world impact?**

Powered by a team with an active learning mindset and client centricity at its core, we deliver lasting value for the world’s leading enterprises.

**Job Description**

You will define and implement the end-to-end security architecture for Databricks on a major cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP). This is a hands-on role responsible for the access, governance, and data-protection model across the platform. You have designed and implemented enterprise security controls for Databricks environments, and you will act as a cross-account authority on security guardrails, access governance, and compliance.

What You Will Do

**Own end-to-end security architecture.** Define and implement the security architecture for Databricks across the platform, from identity through data protection.

**Manage identity and access.** Own SSO/MFA integration and RBAC/ABAC access models, and establish access governance processes across accounts and workspaces.

**Secure Unity Catalog.** Design and enforce Unity Catalog security, data classification, and fine-grained access controls (row, column, and attribute level).

**Secure Delta Sharing and open sharing.** Ensure only approved data is exposed across cross-account and open sharing, with reliable, measurable revocation.

**Design least privilege and blast-radius containment.** Establish the lowest practical access boundary, preventing access to adjacent business-unit data and storage.

**Control privileged access and configuration drift.** Govern privileged elevation and break-glass access, and detect unauthorized changes with monitored alert latency and remediation.

**Protect data and secrets.** Establish controls for encryption, secrets management, and network security aligned to relevant regulatory compliance requirements.

**Build guardrails and auditability.** Set up security guardrails, auditability, and access governance so the platform stays compliant and controllable as it scales.

**Provide cross-account technical leadership.** Act as a go-to security reviewer across multiple accounts, contributing to design reviews and resolving access and governance issues that individual delivery teams cannot.

What You Bring (Required)

Hands-on experience designing and implementing security for enterprise Databricks environments.

Deep Unity Catalog security experience: RBAC/ABAC, fine-grained (row/column/attribute) access, data classification, and Delta Sharing / open sharing controls.

Least-privilege and blast-radius design across business units, containing access to adjacent data and storage.

Privileged access management experience: controlled elevation, break-glass, configuration-drift detection, and remediation.

Strong identity and access management background: SSO/MFA integration and access governance.

Expertise in encryption, secrets management, and network security on at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

Working knowledge of regulatory compliance requirements relevant to data platforms.

Ability to design and run proof-of-control tests and quantify outcomes (e.g., revocation time, data exposure, drift-detection and alert latency), not just implement.

Nice to Have (Preferred)

Databricks Cloud Platform Architect accreditation (AWS, Azure, or GCP) or Databricks Platform Administrator.

Recognized cloud security certification (e.g., AWS or Azure security specialty, or CISSP). Note that Databricks has no standalone security certification, so security credentials come from the cloud provider or an industry body.

Multi-cloud experience across two or more of AWS, Azure, and GCP.

Regulated-industry experience (financial services, healthcare, or similar).

What This Role Is Not

This is a Databricks-native security and access architect role. It is not a general enterprise or datacenter security role. The right candidate has genuinely designed and implemented access, governance, and data-protection controls inside Databricks environments, distinct from a generalist security engineer without hands-on Databricks depth.

**Qualifications**

Bachelors - Business Analytics, Bachelors - Computer Science, Bachelors - Statistics, Masters - Data Science

**Certifications**

Certified Data Management Professional - RiversandRiversand, Databricks Certified Associate Developer for Apache Spark 3.0 - Databricks AcademyDatabricks Academy, Databricks Certified Associate Developer for Apache Spark - Databricks AcademyDatabricks Academy, Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate - MicrosoftMicrosoft, Oracle Database 12c Certified Implementation Specialist - OracleOracle

title: Sr Engineer IT Infrastructure Engineering
description:
**Role Purpose**
================

A Senior IT Infrastructure Engineer designs, builds, secures, and scales an organization's core technology systems across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. The role combines deep hands-on expertise across enterprise compute, storage, and virtualization with knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS or GCP).

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* **System Reliability, Monitoring & Capacity Planning:** Design, build, and maintain highly available, scalable systems across hybrid and cloud environments. Define SLIs/SLOs, build out the monitoring and observability roadmap, and analyze resource usage to forecast and manage capacity as traffic and data grow.
* **Infrastructure as Code, Automation & CI/CD:** Architect and maintain end-to-end CI/CD pipelines and code-driven infrastructure, automating provisioning and reducing manual operational work to enable rapid, safe, and repeatable delivery.
* **Hybrid & Cloud Platform Engineering:** Serve as technical lead for the full lifecycle of on-prem and cloud-based resources — compute, storage, backup, and virtualization — and design secure, cost-effective cloud architectures, including migration of on-premises workloads to the cloud.
* **FinOps & Cost Optimization:** Drive FinOps best practices by monitoring, analyzing, and optimizing cloud spend, including cost allocation and reporting.
* **Advanced Troubleshooting & Incident Response:** Serve as the final escalation point for high-impact technical challenges, providing Tier 3 support and leading incident response to minimize downtime across on-prem and cloud systems.
* **Security & Compliance:** Maintain a strong security baseline across platform and cloud services and ensure compliance with standards such as SOC 2 and PCI-DSS.
* **Mentorship, Collaboration & Documentation:** Guide and mentor junior engineers, conduct code reviews, and promote SRE/DevOps best practices; partner with development, architecture, and security teams, and maintain comprehensive documentation and standards.

**Key Skills & Qualifications**
===============================

**1. Compute & Storage Skills**
-------------------------------

* 10+ years of progressive IT infrastructure engineering experience, with a proven track record in global enterprise environments.
* Deep, hands-on expertise across Operating Systems (Windows and Linux), enterprise storage, backup (Veeam or similar), and virtualization/hyper-converged systems (Nutanix), including physical infrastructure in on-prem or hybrid environments.
* Strong networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, routing, DNS, VPN, SMTP) and core security practices (SSL/TLS, SSH, encryption, LDAP).
* Experience with configuration management (Chef, Ansible, Puppet) and orchestration platforms (CloudBolt, Rundeck).
* Automation and scripting experience (e.g., Python, Shell, PowerShell) to reduce manual work and improve operational efficiency.
* Relevant industry certifications (Microsoft, Red Hat, Nutanix, VMware, backup/storage, Cisco, or security-related) are a plus.

**2. Cloud Skills**
-------------------

* Deep, hands-on expertise with at least one major cloud platform (AWS or GCP) — including compute, storage, networking, database, and security services; multi-cloud or hybrid cloud experience preferred.
* Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, or Azure Resource Manager) and cloud networking concepts (VPCs, subnets, routing, load balancing, DNS, Direct Connect, hybrid connectivity).
* Experience leading migration of on-premises applications and data to the cloud.
* Demonstrated experience driving FinOps strategies to optimize cloud spend without compromising performance or security.
* In-depth knowledge of cloud security best practices and compliance frameworks (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS).
* Professional-level cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect) are a plus.

**Additional Qualifications**
-----------------------------

* Exceptional analytical and strategic problem-solving skills, with the ability to correlate and troubleshoot complex issues across diverse platforms.
* Excellent communication, documentation, and mentoring skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences, and a solid understanding of the project management lifecycle.

**Education**
=============

Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience.

title: Senior Security Specialist
description:
**Role Summary**

The Cybersecurity Architecture Reviewer is responsible for conducting security architecture assessments for applications, platforms, cloud services, infrastructure, and technology solutions to ensure alignment with enterprise security policies, architectural standards, and industry best practices. The role includes reviewing firewall connectivity requests, network security designs, and application integrations to identify risks and recommend secure solutions while enabling business delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct cybersecurity architecture reviews for new and existing applications, platforms, cloud services, and technology solutions.

* Review cloud, on-premises, hybrid, and third-party integrations to ensure secure architectural design and connectivity patterns.

* Assess solution designs, architecture diagrams, data flows, technical documentation, and technical requirements from a security perspective.

* Review firewall and network access requests to validate compliance with approved architectures, security standards, and business requirements.

* Evaluate security controls, including authentication, authorization, encryption, logging, monitoring, and data protection mechanisms.

* Partner with Solution Architects, Engineering Teams, and Project Teams to embed security requirements into solution designs and development initiatives.

* Perform firewall policy reviews across traditional, next-generation, and virtualized firewall platforms.

* Design, implement, and support firewall governance processes, including rule recertification, change management, audit traceability, and exception management.

* Design and assess secure connectivity patterns aligned with enterprise security principles, architectural standards, and regulatory requirements.

* Provide security recommendations, architectural guidance, and risk mitigation strategies based on industry best practices and organizational standards.

* Support governance activities, including periodic access reviews, firewall rule recertification, security exception reviews, and compliance assessments.

* Operate and maintain metrics, dashboards, and reporting to measure the effectiveness and efficiency of the Security Architecture function.

* Document security findings, risks, recommendations, and review outcomes, ensuring effective stakeholder communication and remediation tracking.

* Evangelise Security Architecture as an enabler as opposed to a blocking point



**Required Skills & Experience**

* Strong understanding of cybersecurity architecture principles and secure solution design practices.
* Experience reviewing cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), on-premises infrastructures, and hybrid architectures.
* Knowledge of network security technologies, including firewalls, proxies, VPNs, network segmentation, and secure remote access solutions.
* Experience with firewall platforms such as Palo Alto, Check Point, Fortinet, Cisco FMC/FTD, VMware NSX, or equivalent technologies.
* Strong understanding of authentication protocols, Identity and Access Management (IAM), encryption technologies, PKI, and key management.
* Experience conducting threat modelling, risk assessments, and security architecture reviews.
* Understanding of API security, SaaS security, vendor risk management, and third-party connectivity assessments.
* Familiarity with security frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, OWASP, and Zero Trust Architecture.
* Strong analytical, stakeholder management, communication, and influencing skills.
* Ability to translate technical risks into business-focused recommendations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Industry certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, SABSA, TOGAF, CCSK, AWS Security Specialty, Azure Security Engineer, or equivalent.
* Experience working in highly regulated industries, including Financial Services, Capital Markets, Banking, Insurance, or Critical Infrastructure sectors.
* Hands-on experience with security architecture governance, firewall review processes /FW operations and compliance activities.
* Experience operating security review processes, risk management frameworks, and enterprise security governance programs.

**Experience Level**

Typically 7-14+ years of cybersecurity experience, with at least 5 years in Security Architecture, Security Review, or Network Security Governance roles

Charles River employees are innovative thinkers, who are dedicated to continuous learning and improvement. We will empower you with the resources you need to grow and develop in your career.

**Job Overview**
----------------

We are seeking a skilled **Salesforce Admin/Deployment Specialist** with strong Salesforce Developer expertise to manage deployments, configuration, release activities and environment governance across our Salesforce ecosystem. This role is responsible for ensuring smooth, compliant and efficient release management across multiple clouds, including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Marketing Cloud and Apttus CPQ/CLM.

  

**\*\*This position will work remote from home office, located in India.\*\***

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**
------------------------------------------

* Deployment & Release Management: Lead and execute deployments across all Salesforce environments using AutoRabit, ensuring accurate and timely releases. Manage sandbox strategy, refresh cycles and data preparation to maintain consistent and reliable environments. Perform detailed impact analysis and manage rollback plans when needed. Oversee version control, metadata alignment and release branching strategies to support parallel development streams. * Collaboration & Best Practices: Work with Solution Architects and Senior Developers to optimize system functionality.

* Additional Skills (Preferred): Experience with Salesforce security models, APIs, CI/CD tools (AutoRabit, Github), and data migration techniques.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**
-------------------

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in IT or Computer Science is preferred
* **Experience:**3 to 5 years of hands-on Salesforce administration and deployment experience across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Apttus CPQ/CLM.

The functions are essential to providing a bridge between strategic vision and operational readiness, to ensure ongoing functional innovation and capability improvement.

Charles River is an early-stage contract research organization (CRO). We have built upon our foundation of laboratory animal medicine and science to develop a diverse portfolio of discovery and safety assessment services, both Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) and non-GLP, to support clients from target identification through preclinical development. Charles River also provides a suite of products and services to support our clients’ clinical laboratory testing needs and manufacturing activities. Utilizing this broad portfolio of products and services enables our clients to create a more flexible drug development model, which reduces their costs, enhances their productivity and effectiveness to increase speed to market.

With over 20,000 employees within 110 facilities in over 20 countries around the globe, we are strategically positioned to coordinate worldwide resources and apply multidisciplinary perspectives in resolving our client’s unique challenges. Our client base includes global pharmaceutical companies, biotechnology companies, government agencies and hospitals and academic institutions around the world.

At Charles River, we are passionate about our role in improving the quality of people’s lives. Our mission, our excellent science and our strong sense of purpose guide us in all that we do, and we approach each day with the knowledge that our work helps to improve the health and well-being of many across the globe. We have proudly worked on 80% of the drugs approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) in the past five years.

We’re committed to providing benefits that elevate your quality of life. title: Senior Technical Support Engineer (AI Solutions)
description:
At NiCE, we don't limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We're ambitious. We're game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you're like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.

#### **So, what's the role all about?**

NiCE is building SPARK, a new internal incubation team that turns great ideas from across CX International into working AI solutions, and then into enterprise-grade tools that roll out to colleagues around the world. Every tool we launch needs a great front door, and that is the Support Helpdesk.

As Support Helpdesk in the SPARK team, you will be the first point of contact for colleagues using the AI tools SPARK builds: answering questions, triaging issues, fixing what you can, and escalating what you cannot, with clear evidence. You are an advanced software engineer at heart, so you can go beyond scripts and FAQs: read logs, test an API call, spot a configuration or prompt problem, and explain it in simple terms.

You will be the primary helpdesk owner, supported by a backup or rotating colleague for cover, and you will partner closely with the AI Architects & Builders and the Change Management & Evangelist. What you learn from users will shape what SPARK builds and improves next.

#### **How will you make an impact?**

You will own the user support experience for SPARK solutions, keeping colleagues productive and feeding what you learn back into the tools.

#### **Support Our Users**

* Be the first point of contact for user questions, access requests, and issues, through the team's support channels
* Triage, prioritise, and track every request through to resolution in the ticketing system, with clear and timely updates to users
* Troubleshoot technical issues by reviewing logs, testing API calls, checking configurations and prompts, reproducing problems, and fixing what is within your reachEscalate to the AI Architects & Builders with clear reproduction steps, evidence, and impact, so engineers can act fast

#### **Build Knowledge**

* Create and maintain FAQs, how-to guides, and a searchable knowledge base for every SPARK solution
* Document known issues, workarounds, and runbooks, and keep them current as solutions change
* Help onboard new users and groups, working with the Change Management & Evangelist on guides and training materials

#### **Spot Patterns and Improve**

* Analyse ticket trends to identify recurring issues, usability gaps, and training needs, and report them to the Change Management & Evangelist and the AI Architects & Builders
* Track support metrics such as volume, response and resolution times, user satisfaction, and top issues, and share regular summaries
* Capture user feedback and feature requests for the product backlog
* Create real time dashboard for requestor to have visibility into progress

#### **Automate and Cover**

* Use scripts and AI tools to automate repetitive support tasks such as triage, routing, FAQ answers, and reporting
* Coordinate with your backup or rotating support colleague to maintain coverage during absences and busy periods
* Help monitor usage and platform health, and raise alerts on anything that looks wrong

#### **Have you got what it takes?**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* 4-8 years of experience as a software engineer, or in L2/L3 application or technical support for software products
* Hands-on technical skills: scripting or programming (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar), SQL, REST APIs, tools such as Postman, and reading application logs
* Experience with ticketing and service management tools such as ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, or similar
* Strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills, and the patience to guide non-technical users clearly
* Excellent written communication: clear, friendly, and concise answers and documentation
* Everyday use of generative AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Copilot, and an understanding of how AI answers can go wrong
* An ownership mindset: you stay with an issue until it is resolved or handed over cleanly
* Fluency in English
* Ability to work support hours that cover the regions the team serves (working pattern to be confirmed)

#### **You will have an advantage if you also have:**

* Experience supporting internal AI tools, chatbots, or agent platforms
* Experience building automations or lightweight bots for support
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure, and with basic CI/CD
* Experience with knowledge base tools and writing technical documentation
* Background in CX, contact centre, CCaaS, or enterprise SaaS support
* Experience supporting users across multiple time zones

#### **What's in it for you?**

SPARK is a chance to be a founding member of a brand-new team, and to shape how NiCE turns AI ideas into everyday tools used by colleagues around the world.

Join an ever-growing, market-disrupting, global company where the teams, comprised of the best of the best, work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NiCE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate about AI, innovative at heart, and excited to constantly raise the bar on what intelligent technology can do, you may just be our next NiCEr!

At NiCE, we work according to the NiCE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.

description:

**Experience:** 7–10 Years  
**Salary:** Competitive  
**Location:** Remote (India)  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Working Days:** 5 Days a Week  
**Shift:** US Time Zone Overlap  
**Notice Period:** Maximum 30 Days

About PyxTech

PyxTech is a B2B SaaS and AI technology company specializing in enterprise software, AI-powered solutions, digital engineering, and technology consulting. We help organizations modernize enterprise architecture, automate workflows, and unlock business value through intelligent data and AI solutions.

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **Semantic Data Architect / Ontologist** with strong expertise in enterprise ontology development, RDF-based semantic modeling, and knowledge graph architecture.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience designing enterprise ontologies, building semantic data models, connecting fragmented enterprise data sources, and implementing W3C semantic web standards to support enterprise search, analytics, and AI-driven applications.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, and maintain enterprise ontologies, taxonomies, and semantic knowledge models.
* Build RDF-based semantic data structures using RDF, RDFS, OWL, and SPARQL.
* Integrate data from multiple enterprise systems into connected knowledge graphs.
* Develop and manage controlled vocabularies, metadata models, and taxonomy lifecycle processes.
* Implement SHACL-based data validation and constraints, along with SKOS for knowledge organization.
* Deploy and manage knowledge graphs using Neo4j, GraphDB, Amazon Neptune, or Stardog.
* Work with ontology and taxonomy management platforms such as PoolParty and TopBraid EDG.
* Optimize semantic models for enterprise search, analytics, metadata extraction, and AI applications.
* Collaborate with data engineers, AI/ML teams, developers, and business stakeholders.
* Support cloud-based deployments using AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes.

Mandatory Skills & Qualifications

* 7+ years of overall IT/data experience.
* **Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience specifically in RDF-based semantic ontology development and modeling.**
* Strong expertise in enterprise ontology design, taxonomy development, and semantic metadata management.
* Expert knowledge of RDF, RDFS, OWL, and SPARQL.
* Practical experience with SHACL and SKOS.
* Production experience with at least one graph database: Neo4j, GraphDB, Amazon Neptune, or Stardog.
* Hands-on experience with at least one ontology/taxonomy management platform, such as PoolParty, TopBraid EDG, or GraphDB (Ontotext).
* Familiarity with AWS, Docker, or Kubernetes.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work with globally distributed teams and overlap with US business hours.
* Maximum notice period of 30 days.

Preferred Skills

* NLP, Named Entity Recognition (NER), and semantic metadata extraction.
* Experience with spaCy or similar NLP tools.
* Experience supporting enterprise search, knowledge discovery, and AI-driven applications.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Library Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline.

Interview Process

* HR Screening and Initial Evaluation
* Client Technical Assessment / Deep Dive
* Client Final / Behavioral Interview

How to Apply

If you have strong hands-on experience in RDF-based ontology engineering, semantic data architecture, and enterprise knowledge graphs, we would love to hear from you.

**Please apply with your updated resume highlighting your ontology projects, RDF experience, graph database expertise, and notice period.**

**Important:** This role requires substantial practical ontology engineering experience, not just general data architecture or basic knowledge of graph databases.

Proven experience driving observability automation and alert optimization

Strong facilitation, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
